harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent OpenTelemetry Collector gateway on node1. OTLP/HTTP HTTPS port 4318 uses mTLS, routes payments only to node2 and inventory only to node3, rejects absent/unsupported namespaces, and retains traces across restarts. All nodes completed serial restart verification successfully.
actions_performed: Installed checksum-verified OpenTelemetry Collector Contrib 0.162.0 on all three nodes.
Created a private CA with separate gateway, backend, internal exporter, and external client identities.
Placed validated client credentials in /root/otel-client on node1 with the private key mode 0600.
Configured exact namespace routing with an explicit rejecting default path.
Configured durable rotation-backed files at /var/lib/otel/payments.json and /var/lib/otel/inventory.json.
Verified successful mTLS routing, rejection without client certificates, invalid-namespace rejection, zero cross-routing, and exactly-once test delivery.
Restarted nodes individually and verified changed boot identities, service recovery, retained data, and post-restart routing.

evidence.requirement: Gateway HTTPS/mTLS configuration and client credentials
evidence.summary: Node1 is enabled, active, listening on 4318, has a validated configuration and explicit client CA, and contains the CA/certificate plus a mode-0600 client key under /root/otel-client.

evidence.requirement: Payments route only to node2 without duplicate delivery
evidence.summary: Post-restart payments submission returned HTTP 200, appeared exactly once on node2, and had zero matches on node3. All three distinct payments verification records occur once.

evidence.requirement: Inventory routes only to node3 without duplicate delivery
evidence.summary: Post-restart inventory submission returned HTTP 200, appeared exactly once on node3, and had zero matches on node2. All three distinct inventory verification records occur once.

evidence.requirement: Missing and unsupported namespaces are rejected
evidence.summary: Both invalid requests returned HTTP 503 after all restarts; neither backend gained invalid records or additional lines.
Gateway and both backend collectors rejected requests without client certificates with a TLS certificate-required alert; authenticated routing succeeded.
Healthy baseline captured, reboot acknowledged, node became temporarily unavailable, boot ID changed, Collector/listener/config/certificate/metrics recovered, and both routes worked afterward.
Healthy baseline captured, reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed, service/listener/metrics and original data recovered, and a new payments trace arrived exactly once.
Healthy baseline captured, reboot acknowledged, boot ID changed, service/listener/metrics and original data recovered, and a new inventory trace arrived exactly once.
